resumeText: Priya Rao is a Solutions Architect at Bluepeak Analytics with five years of experience, starting as a Software Engineer and moving through a Cloud Engineer role at Quantia Labs before stepping into architecture. She designs AWS-based microservices systems and containerized deployments, and is actively building her enterprise integration and cost optimization skills.
